You’ve got a few solid, GCC-friendly options for **Eid beauty gifts** (gift sets, perfume, skincare, plus gift wrap / notes):

## Best “order online + deliver in the GCC” options

### 1) **Sephora Middle East (UAE/KSA/KW/BH/OM/QA)**
Good for: popular makeup/skincare sets, perfume gift sets, easy gifting.  
Their FAQ lists coverage across **Saudi, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar** (and UAE via stores/online depending on market). ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/ae-en/faq?utm_source=openai))

### 2) **Ounass (delivers across the GCC)**
Good for: premium/luxury beauty and fragrance gift sets, fast delivery in some cities.

They also run Ramadan/Eid edits and gift sets regularly. ([en-saudi.ounass.com](https://en-saudi.ounass.com/women/ramadan-shop/ramadan-ready?utm_source=openai))

### 3) **Golden Scent (GCC fragrance specialist)**
Good for: perfume-heavy Eid gifting, usually gift-wrapping options.  
Their app listing notes **gift wrap** availability, and they have delivery support pages. ([play.google.com](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en-US&id=com.goldenscent.c3po&utm_source=openai))

### 4) **Local/Regional perfume brands doing Eid packaging**
If you want something explicitly “Eid Mubarak” themed, some regional perfume brands sell **Eid-labeled gift sets** with GCC delivery (example: LAVERNE’s Eid mini set listing mentions Eid packaging and UAE delivery). ([laverne.co](https://laverne.co/products/laverne-eid-gifts-5-perfumes?utm_source=openai))
